responses.text: What are you doing here, stranger? You looking to start some trouble?
Thanks for talking Pauline out of robbing the Strip. Who knows what she'll think of next?
So? That's just one of our crimes! We're depraved, stone-cold degenerates, you know? You don't want to mess with us!

topics.prompt: I know the two of you stole Vance's gun down in Primm.
topics.label: I know you have the gun, Sammy.

responses.text: Simple! Up 'til now, we committed our crimes stealthily, leaving no evidence behind. So we never built a rep.
But that's gonna change with our next score. You just wait and see.

topics.prompt: You sound pretty tough. I wonder why I've never heard of you.

responses.text: Really? Oh, thank god! I love that woman, but I swear this time she was gonna get us killed!
The gun's in the safe. The combination's 05-23-34. Take it far away from here, before she changes her mind.

topics.prompt: Pauline says you should give me the gun.
topics.label: I convinced Pauline that you shouldn't go through with this.

responses.text: You'll have to ask Pauline about that! She's the brains of our operation. I'm the muscle.
Me? I'm Sammy, of Sammy and Pauline, the wasteland's most dangerous and notorious criminal duo!
You better not mess with us or you'll end up face down in a shallow grave!
Thanks for talking us out of our evil ways. I'm starting on that novel soon. Pauline is so happy. You are a nice person! Hurray!
